title: Text model routing changes
summary:
Text models changed routes, the API docs got easier to navigate, and a community speech tool joined the projects list.

`openai-large` now routes to GPT-4.1, `openai` to GPT-4o mini, and `openai-fast` and `openai-roblox` to GPT-4.1 nano. Bidara moved from Seed-tier to anonymous access. The API now returns an error for invalid authentication tokens rather than trying another authentication method, and `openai-audio` has a 1,000-character input limit.

The API docs now have clearer endpoint navigation and examples for multimodal requests, vision, speech-to-text, function calling, and text-to-speech. Site examples also show how to use a reference image with Kontext via `?model=kontext&image=URL`; its Seed-tier eligibility did not change.

Argent Script, a community text-to-speech tool, joined the Creative Projects listing. Behind the scenes, new scripts make it possible to sample cached GPT Image outputs and organize image-to-image inputs, prompts, and metadata for analysis.
